Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

Contact.description: Contact information for an organization role.

name.description: Full name of the contact person or organizational unit.

ContactRole.description: Functional responsibility of an organization contact.

oneOf.description: The open-data desk: the role address a dataset's catalogue record names as its contact point, which the Portal prefills into an Endpoint's `spec.catalog` (EP-78, EP-80).

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

OrganizationSpec.description: Desired specification of an [`Organization`][crate::kinds::Organization] resource (PF-01, PF-02, PF-25, PF-41).

contacts.description: Administrative, technical, data protection, or security contacts.

defaultLocale.description: Organization fallback default locale, MUST be one of [`Self::locales`] (PF-25, PF-26).

domain.description: Verified internet FQDN, the `{orgDomain}` of every entity URN (PF-41).

gitRepositoryUrl.description: Git repository URL of the one Org Repository in Gitea (PF-02).

locales.description: Ordered list of supported locales, most preferred first (PF-25).

projects.description: How projects are opened and who sees them (PF-61, PF-65).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

ProjectCreation.description: Who may open a project (PF-65). `group:<name>` names a `Group` of the organization.

oneOf.description: Every signed-in person of the organization.

ProjectVisibility.description: Who holds the seeded `viewer` role at organization scope (PF-61).

oneOf.description: Every signed-in person of the organization reads every project.
Only a principal a binding names reads a project.

ProjectsPolicy.description: The organization's rules for its projects (PF-61, PF-65).

creation.description: Who may open a project: `anyone`, `group:<name>` or `org-admin` (PF-65).

nameCooldownDays.description: How long a deleted project's name stays reserved, in days (PF-78). Absent is [`DEFAULT_NAME_COOLDOWN_DAYS`]; `0` frees the name the moment the project is gone.

quota.description: The quota every project the organization opens starts from (PF-73). A project may lower a value in the yellow lane; raising one above this is the red lane and an `org-admin`.

visibility.description: Who holds the seeded `viewer` role at organization scope: every signed-in person of the organization (`organization`, the default) or only whoever a binding names (`members`) (PF-61).

Quotas.description:
Structural resource quotas per project (PF-17).

An absent field indicates unlimited quota for that resource.

agentRunsPerDay.description: Maximum number of agent runs the project starts in one day (PF-73, PF-74).

apps.description: Maximum number of Apps the project deploys (PF-73).

contextSpaces.description: Maximum number of active Context Spaces.

entitiesPerSpace.description: Maximum number of entities one Context Space of the project holds (PF-73).

ingestEventsPerSecond.description: Maximum ingestion rate in events per second.

requestsPerMinute.description: Maximum requests per minute one Endpoint of the project serves (PF-73, EP-17).

residentPipelines.description: Maximum number of resident streaming pipelines.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
